meta.description: Edit phylogenetic tree structure with Biopython Bio.Phylo (rooting, pruning, clade extraction, collapsing low-support branches, resolving polytomies, ladderizing), treating rooting as a separate statistical inference with outgroup/midpoint/MAD/MinVar/non-reversible tradeoffs.
meta.executed: 6/7 inputs executed (Biopython 1.88, ete3 3.1.3, DendroPy 5.0.13, ape 5.8.1, phangorn 2.12.1, phytools 2.5.2, IQ-TREE 2.4.0, MAD 2.2 mad.py, FastRoot/MinVar 1.5 under Python 3.12); Input 6 is a routing answer with no code
meta.execution_note: All trees and alignments are SYNTHETIC: IQ-TREE AliSim simulations from known rooted trees (data/make_data.py), followed by unrooted ML inference with -B 1000 -alrt 1000, so every rooting was scored against the true root. The four shipped examples and the Skill's snippets were run as written. RootDigger and Newick Utilities have no Windows builds and were NOT executed; Newick Utilities program semantics were checked against the help text in the tjunier/newick_utils source.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated citations or numbers; every reported root, distance and support value came from runs on the synthetic data. Cited references (Tria 2017, Mai 2017, Bettisworth 2021, Hess and Russo 2007, DeSalle 2023, Junier 2010) are real.

practice_boundaries.detail: Pure research phylogenetics; nothing diagnoses, prescribes or triages an individual.

methodological_ground.detail: Rooting-as-inference, soft vs hard polytomy, distance-preserving pruning and distant-outgroup warnings are sound. One heuristic (prefer MAD/MinVar agreement) produced a confidently wrong root on a strong lineage-rate-shift tree (Input 4), but the Skill's own method table flags that condition; recorded as P2, not a principled fallacy.

code_usability.detail: All Skill snippets and all four examples parse and run on Biopython 1.88 / ape 5.8.1 without errors. Two snippets are logically wrong on real IQ-TREE output (the outgroup monophyly guard refuses a valid outgroup; collapse_all is a silent no-op on SH-aLRT/UFBoot labels). They run, so these are P1 correctness defects rather than unrunnable code.

functional_suitability.note: Covers rooting, pruning, induced subtrees, collapsing and resolving; ladderize has no code, and non-reversible IQ-TREE/RootDigger are named without commands. Correctness 2/4. Verified correct: ape has no midpoint, drop.tip and Bio.Phylo prune sum lengths, ete3 needs preserve_branch_length, di2multi tol filters length, the MAD/FastRoot commands work. Wrong on real IQ-TREE output: the outgroup guard, collapse on dual labels, the 1e-8 zero-length tolerance, and nw_condense (it collapses pure clades, not low-support branches).

reliability.note: Useful Common Errors table and introspect-and-adapt rule; failure modes are written as trigger/mechanism/symptom/fix. But the monophyly guard misfires, and nothing detects that support labels were not parsed into .confidence, so collapse fails silently.

performance_context.note: 216-line SKILL.md plus 77-line usage guide, dense tables, no redundant steps; all loaded at once but compact.

agent_usability.note: Clear conceptual guidance and strong error prevention (distance checks, soft polytomy labelling, LBA). Misses the traps that bite on real ML output: IQ-TREE's basal trifurcation, root_with_outgroup making a trifurcating root, dual support labels, IQ-TREE's 1e-6 branch floor. No prescribed report format for root uncertainty.

human_usability.note: Usage guide has natural prompts for each operation; description is long and jargon-dense.

security.note: No credentials or network use; local file edits only; no validation that taxon names exist before pruning or rooting.

maintainability.note: Separate, small, runnable examples; prune_taxa.py self-checks a distance. Examples use toy single-label trees that hide the dual-label and IQ-TREE-orientation failures, and common_ancestor.py prints 'Clade' as the answer to 'monophyletic?'.

agent_specific.note: Precise trigger with explicit routing to tree-io, tree-visualization, divergence-dating and modern-tree-inference (all present); deterministic edits. Escape hatches are good for rooting uncertainty, but there is no guidance for when to stop because support labels could not be read.

recommendations.title: Outgroup guard refuses valid outgroups on IQ-TREE trees
recommendations.problem: On IQ-TREE output written as (OutA,OutB,ingroup), 'if tree.is_monophyletic([...])' returns False and the snippet prints 'root placement is unreliable'. root_with_outgroup on an internal outgroup makes a trifurcating root, and is a no-op when the outgroup MRCA is the current root.
recommendations.root_cause: The snippet tests rooted-tree monophyly on an arbitrarily rooted tree and ignores Biopython's documented root_with_outgroup edge cases.
recommendations.fix: First root on an ingroup tip (tree.root_with_outgroup(ingroup_tip)), then test outgroup monophyly, then call root_with_outgroup(*outgroup, outgroup_branch_length=stem/2) for a bifurcating root. Add a Common Errors row for the false negative.

recommendations.title: collapse_all silently no-ops on SH-aLRT/UFBoot labels
recommendations.problem: IQ-TREE -B -alrt trees carry 'SH-aLRT/UFBoot' labels, which Bio.Phylo leaves in clade.name with confidence None, so the Skill's collapse lambda collapses nothing and raises no error.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill asserts 'support parsed into clade.confidence' and its example uses single-number labels only.
recommendations.fix: Add a parser (ufboot = float(c.name.split('/')[1]) when '/' in c.name) and an assertion that at least one internal node has readable support before collapsing. Add a dual-label case to examples/collapse_support.py.

recommendations.title: Zero-length tolerance 1e-8 misses IQ-TREE's 1e-6 floor
recommendations.problem: IQ-TREE writes 0.000001 for zero-length branches; branch_length < 1e-8 catches none of them.
recommendations.root_cause: Tolerance taken from ape's di2multi default rather than from the inference program's minimum branch length.
recommendations.fix: Use <= 1e-6 for IQ-TREE trees (MAD also contracts <1e-6) and say the tolerance must match the program that wrote the tree.

recommendations.title: Collapsing changes patristic distances; say so
recommendations.problem: The ape recipe (zero low-support lengths, then di2multi) changed subset distances by up to 0.093. Bio.Phylo collapse_all instead pushes the length to children, which changes within-clade distances.
recommendations.root_cause: The Skill's distance-preservation warning covers pruning only.
recommendations.fix: State that any collapse alters some patristic distances; collapse on a copy used for display or topology, and keep the resolved tree for distance-based work.

recommendations.title: MAD/MinVar agreement is not root confidence
recommendations.problem: On a tree with a strong clade-wide rate shift, MAD and MinVar agreed on the same wrong root; only the non-reversible IQ-TREE test recovered the true root, and it still left 7 AU-plausible roots.
recommendations.root_cause: The decision rule treats agreement as sufficient and gives no command for the likelihood route.
recommendations.fix: Require reporting MAD's ambiguity index (AI near 1 = ambiguous). Add the command 'iqtree2 -s aln --model-joint 12.12 -B 1000 --root-test -zb 1000 -au' and report the rootstrap plus the AU confidence set of root branches.

recommendations.title: Bio.Phylo Newick root ':0' breaks MAD 2.2
recommendations.problem: Trees written by Bio.Phylo after prune or root end in '):0;', which mad.py rejects with 'Corrupt NEWICK format'.
recommendations.root_cause: Tool interoperability not tested between the Skill's Python edits and the outgroup-free CLIs it recommends.
recommendations.fix: Strip the root branch length before calling mad, e.g. newick.replace('):0;', ');'), and note it next to the MAD command.

recommendations.title: Small doc defects: example output, nw_condense, ladderize
recommendations.problem: common_ancestor.py prints 'Are Human, Chimp, Gorilla monophyletic? Clade'. nw_condense collapses pure (same-label) clades, not low-support branches. Ladderize is in scope but has no code.
recommendations.root_cause: Examples and tool table not checked against actual output or tool help.
recommendations.fix: Print bool(tree.is_monophyletic(...)); list nw_ed with a support address for support-based collapse; add tree.ladderize() with the no-biology caveat.
